turns.content: How do I get wifi on my computer, visuals please

Good news! Your computer is already connected to the internet and working well. However, I created this visual guide so you can see exactly how to check your Wi-Fi (wireless internet) connection. And connect to different networks anytime you need to. This is perfect for when you want to connect to a different Wi-Fi (wireless internet) network (like at a coffee shop. Or friend's house) or if you ever need to reconnect at home.

To connect to Wi-Fi, follow these steps:

**Step 1: Ensure your device is connected**

* Make sure your device (computer/laptop/sp phone/tablet) is turned on and awake. * Check that you have a stable internet connection. **Step 2: Locate the Wi-Fi settings**

* On Windows: Click on the network small picture on your screen (also called a icon) in the bottom bar (also called a taskbar) (usually located at the bottom right of the screen). This will open the network window. You can also search for "Wi-Fi" in the Start menu. * On Mac/MacBook: Click on the Wi-Fi small picture on your screen (also called a icon) in the top navigation bar. Or press Command + Space to open Spotlight Search. Type "Wi-Fi" and select it from the results. **Step 3: Select your Wi-Fi network**

* In the network window, look for a list of available Wi-Fi networks (your own network will be listed). * Click on the name of your network (using mouse) and hold it until you see the "Connect" option. * Release the clickable portion of the network's small picture on your screen (also called a icon) to connect. If prompted enter our password: (Your WiFi Password)

**Step 4: Authentication**

If you are prompted for a password, type it in to get connected.

Your computer is actually already connected to the internet right now, so you're all set at home! 🎉

But here's a visual step-by-step guide you can follow anytime you need to connect to a new Wi-Fi network — like at a coffee shop, library, or a friend's house. The password is almost always on a sticker on the internet box (internet box (also called a router)), so look there first!
How to connect to google chrome

Google Chrome is the app you use to visit websites — it's the colorful circle on your screen. Here's a visual guide showing exactly where to find it and how to open it. Once it's open, you can type any website name at the top to go there! 🌐
